findings.issue: P123.91 resolved the unreadable-plan case by KEEPING the phase lock (lock_to_give_back returns False plus a note), not by releasing it as the finding's resolution asked. drive()'s docstring still says every other non-zero return after the lock was taken gives it back 'so no refusal strands it', which the new branch contradicts, and the printed claim 'a later next releases it' is not pinned: dl11 asserts only that the lock is still held and the line is printed, never that a following next gives it back. If the plan stays unreadable the lock stays taken, which is the stranded-lock shape the phase's desired outcome rules out.
findings.resolution: Either release on OSError (return give_back True with the note) as the finding offered, or amend drive()'s docstring to name this one kept-lock case and extend dl11 with a second next over a readable plan asserting the lock is released.
